---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new skill, port, or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

What problem are you solving? Be specific about the gap.

## Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed change. If this is a new skill, include:
- Triggering conditions (when it auto-loads)
- Core principle
- Workflow steps
- Anti-patterns and red flags

## Scope Check

- [ ] Would this benefit any Hermes user, not just my project?
- [ ] Does it avoid third-party dependencies?
- [ ] Have I tested this in a fresh Hermes session?

## Test Results

If you have a working version, paste test results or session transcripts here.
